build.title: claude-pick.sh: choose plan or API key at launch

said.text: On the VPS, deploy/claude-pick.sh asks at launch whether Claude Code uses the Claude plan login or an Anthropic API key (billed per use). Key read from ~/.anthropic-key (0600), never the repo; export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY only for that launch; option to save/replace/remove the key; show which is active. Plan is the default. Note: claude.ai connectors and /schedule are unavailable while the API key is active.
